turns.text: Hi, I'm Owen's teacher. Thanks for coming in.
Why was the zero entered before anyone called me?
Okay. Setting the grade aside for a second.
Setting it aside isn't an answer. Who decided on the zero, and was it before or after anyone spoke to Owen?
If you were me, what would you do here? Genuinely.
I'm not here to do your job. Who decided on the zero?
